title: NOTIFICATION OF PHOCAS FINANCIAL CORPORATION CLOSURE, APPROVAL OF
text:
[E. REPORTS TO THE BOARD]
NOTIFICATION OF PHOCAS FINANCIAL CORPORATION CLOSURE, APPROVAL OF
  REVISION TO U.S. EQUITY STRUCTURE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN, APPROVAL OF ONE-
  YEAR CONTRACT EXTENSION WITH ALLIANCEBERNSTEIN, L.P. FOR DOMESTIC
  SMALL CAP VALUE EQUITY INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES, AND POSSIBLE
  BOARD ACTION
summary: LAFPP receives notification of Phocas Financial Corporation closure, approves revision to U.S. equity structure implementation plan, and approves one-year contract extension with AllianceBernstein for domestic small cap value equity investment management.

details.action: Notification and approvals regarding investment management
